messages:
Jordan: uploaded the recurrence heatmap for Feb–Mar, link: https://redwood.internal/heatmaps/recur-2026. Can folks triage the top 6 hotspots?
Samira: looked through it, biggest cluster is GPU OOMs during nightly batch jobs and then short spikes of 5xx on the hosted API around 04:00 UTC.
Alex: agree — OOMs are 42% of repeats. Most of those are on the same instance types after model rollout 2026-02-18.
Maria: the 04:00 spikes look like autoscaler flapping + cache cold starts. I suspect prefix/KV eviction + scaling policy mismatch.
Jordan: OpsBot also posted per-cluster histograms earlier; OpsBot: incident-digest posted for 1977999000..1978002000.
OpsBot: automated note: recurring incidents tag applied: "oom-nightly" (count 12), "autoscale-spike" (count 9), "model-rollback" (count 3).
Esteban: I'll take the quantized-model fallback tests for the OOMs. Esteban -> will run a canary with 4-bit quantization on a dedicated pool. ETA 2026-03-10.
Samira: I can own the autoscale-flap investigation. Plan: capture 1 week of scaler events + allocation logs and validate the cooldown settings. ETA 2026-03-05.
Alex: I'll try to reproduce the OOM locally with a synthetic load profile. If I can repro we'll pin a mitigator by next week.
Maria: propose short-term mitigations: 1) increase warm pool for nightly batch by +20% for two weeks. 2) Pin older model variant during rollout windows.
Jordan: good. Let's capture these as action items. I'll open a follow-up doc and a small kanban board.
Jordan: action list (new):
```
- AO-1: Increase nightly warm pool by +20% (temp) -> owner: Maria -> due: 2026-03-03
- AO-2: Autoscaler cooldown audit + fix -> owner: Samira -> due: 2026-03-05
- AO-3: Repro OOM locally + mitigator -> owner: Alex -> due: 2026-03-04
- AO-4: Canary quantized fallback tests -> owner: Esteban -> due: 2026-03-10
- AO-5: Postmortem follow-up doc linking incidents -> owner: Jordan -> due: 2026-03-07
```
Samira: small note — for AO-2 I want permission to change cooldown to 120s on staging first. Jordan: granted.
Maria: AO-1 scheduled the change at 02:15 UTC to avoid user-facing windows.
Alex: added a quick local repro script snippet to the thread: `python repro_oom.py --model gptx-6b --seq 1024 --batch 8`
Esteban: will surface perf delta in the canary and add a fallback policy check: model-rollback threshold at 5xx rate 0.5% over 3 minutes.
Jordan: also want a small recurring check: can we add a monthly heatmap job that auto-tags recurring signatures and notifies owners? OpsBot: can be scheduled.
OpsBot: scheduled job created: recur-heatmap-monthly -> first run 2026-04-01. Notifying owners @Samira @Maria.
Maria: nit — let's include the KV cache miss rate in the monthly artifact. That will help catch cold-start clusters.
Samira: acked. Also: I'll add a short test matrix for autoscaler config permutations.
Jordan: ok. Please update the kanban cards when you hit these milestones. We'll reconvene in 2 weeks for a quick sync.
Alex: :thumbsup:
Esteban: :thumbsup: I'll drop results into the canary thread when done.
Samira: adding a summary comment to the incidents tracker with links to the AO items.
Jordan: thanks all. If anyone runs into blockers ping me in #eng-sre.
Maria: pinged infra on increasing warm-pool quota.
Jordan: last note — flagging AO-3 and AO-4 as high priority since they reduce recurrence likelihood the most.
Alex: noted.
Esteban: noted.
OpsBot: reminder set: AO-1 due in 3 days, AO-2 due in 6 days.
